name: REELMO — Real-Time Emotional Responses to Movies
description: A Figshare release of 1,060 hours of moment-by-moment emotional reports collected from 161 participants across 20 affective states while they watched 60 full-length movies, together with personality and empathy measures, movie synopses and liking ratings. A separate fMRI component records 20 volunteers watching the full-length film Jojo Rabbit. Visual and acoustic features plus deep-learning-derived semantic content accompany the reports, so affect can be modelled against the stimulus directly. The combination of full-length films, dense continuous self-report and a matched fMRI sample suits work on affective chronometry, mixed-valence states, narrative structure and trait moderation of emotional experience.
citation: Sampaolo E, Handjaras G, Lettieri G, Cecchetti L. (2025). Lights, Camera, Emotion: REELMO's 1060 Hours of Affective Reports to Explore Emotions in Naturalistic Settings. Scientific Data, 12, 797.

publications.title: Lights, Camera, Emotion: REELMO's 1060 Hours of Affective Reports to Explore Emotions in Naturalistic Settings
